expires_today.title: Your idea. Your design. Your way. CorelDRAW Go - No Experience Required
expires_today.description: Your Golden Ticket to CorelDRAW Go!
expires_today.long_description: Take your graphics projects further with the unrivaled creative control of CorelDRAW Go. Whether you create unique designs for fun or run your own business, CorelDRAW Go provides highly intuitive features that go beyond the basics—design logos, stationery, marketing materials, art, home decor, and so much more. This Humble Bundle exclusively offers members a 12-month subscription for the low price of $10—that’s 11 months for free! Save big on effortless online graphic design software, and help support Optimist International Foundation with your purchase.

expires_today.title: The Triple-i Initiative Showcase Bundle
expires_today.description: A no-bloat showcase of player-first games!
expires_today.long_description:
Buckle up for The Triple-i Initiative Showcase Bundle, an all-star collection of titles that celebrates the culture without extra fluff, hosts, or bloat. Unlock great games with exceptional value like X4: Foundations, The Last Spell - Complete Edition, and more! We’re proud to be a sponsor of the Triple-i Initiative Showcase. Catch up on their recent showcase to see what exciting new games will be highlighted this year! Plus, a portion of this purchase helps support Gamers Outreach!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 29th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Celebrating 100 Years of Mindfulness, Peace, and Compassion: The Essential Thich Nhat Hanh Collection
expires_tomorrow.long_description: On what would be globally influential spiritual activist Thich Nhat Hanh’s 100th Birthday, celebrate a century of mindfulness and peace with this collection of his essential books! Turn suffering into joy with No Mud, No Lotus. Learn key Buddhist mindfulness practices with Interbeing, 4th Edition and The Mindfulness Survival Kit. Content yourself with living in the moment with Happiness. Learn to live a more grounded, compassionate lifestyle with all of these books and more, included in this bundle at the price of your choice! Pay what you want and support the Thich Nhat Hanh Foundation with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Gals and Pals: PQube Japanese Games
expires_tomorrow.description: Explore PQube’s gorgeous girls of gaming
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
The content in this bundle is intended for mature audiences.

Fall into an intimate bundle of spicy Japanese games with the Gals and Pals Bundle published by PQube! Turn up the heat in Gal*Gun Returns, a colorfully reimagined version of the first game that started it all, the sensual sequel Gal*Gun 2, or the action-packed Gal*Gun: Double Peace! Massage your romantic impulses with these rail-shooters of beautiful bubbly girls, and fulfill your euphoric fantasies where bullets have been replaced with enchanting pheromone shots! Unwrap steamy gal-pal fun for a price you choose and help support Cool Effect with your purchase.

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 30th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Twisted Trilogies and Terrors: Dark Visual Novels
expires_tomorrow.description: Twisted trilogies and terrifying tales await.
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
The content in this bundle is intended for mature audiences.

Sink your teeth into the Twisted Trilogies and Terrors: Dark Visual Novel Bundle, a seasonal collection of scary games! Choose from a trio of Spirit Hunter titles, including the critically acclaimed Death Mark II. Spooky supernatural studies are in session within the halls of Tokyo’s Konoehara Academy, and it’s your duty as a Spirit Doctor to cleanse the prestigious academy’s classrooms with your partner. Or try Class of '09, a trilogy of anti-visual novel games where you play as a beautiful heroine who causes chaos for every suitor who tries to gain your affection. Plus, your purchase helps support Movember!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 30th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Dungeon Adventures! - 3D Printable Miniatures & Scenery
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Your campaign is as real as you make it, so why not give it some life? Fill your dungeons with characters and scenery with this bundle of 3D printable miniatures from Hayland Terrain and Warp Miniatures! Get over 90 software files for absolutely everything you need—from giant ants and bats to rock elementals, spooky sewer entrances, tombs, market stalls, and more! Build your environments and fill them with characters, creatures, and tons of detail to give your players a whole world of adventure! Grab this bundle at the brice of your choice, and support Make-A-Wish with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Gamer's Kitchen Cookbooks by Insight Editions
expires_tomorrow.description: Games have never looked so delicious
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Cook your way through your favorite games with this bundle of official and unofficial video game recipe books! Fry up tasty street food and mix some criminally delicious cocktails with An Unofficial Grand Theft Auto Cookbook! Fill up on sweetrolls and brew an apple cabbage stew any tavern keeper would envy with The Elder Scrolls: The Official Cookbook! Quench your thirst with the Wasteland-inspired libations in Fallout: The Official Drinks Book! Throw a gamer dinner party or cook up a multi-course meal for one with the 27 recipe books included in this collection! Grab them now at the price of your choice, and support NatureBridge with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Capcom Classics Bundle
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Return to the good old days with this bundle of classic Capcom games! If you saw the movie and caught Resident Evil fever, now you can play the first three games in the franchise and see how well you’d survive Raccoon City! And, from the same team that brought you all those gooey T-virus monsters, we’ve also included the first two Dino Crisis games, for those of you who wish Jurassic Park had more survival horror. And, for a modern spin on a classic, we also have 2026’s Breath of Fire IV, where a princess searches for her missing sister through two civilizations united by a precarious alliance. Experience the fun and adventure of classic Capcom at the price of your choosing, and support Breakthrough T1D with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 30th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Cybersecurity Month 2026 by O'Reilly
expires_tomorrow.description: Fortify your digital worlds with elite cybersecurity.
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Online scams and malware are everywhere in 2026—what are you doing to protect yourself? Prevent security breaches before they happen with the techniques and tools from the Humble Tech Book Bundle: Cybersecurity Month by O’Reilly. Top titles from this curated library include Learning Cloud Security and Software Supply Chain Security. Learn software supply chain security and DevSecOps, build an original cyber risk management program, and more. Pay what you want to gain essential digital defense skills and help support Code for America with your purchase.

expires_tomorrow.title: Gatchaman and Speed Racer by Mad Cave Studios
expires_tomorrow.description: Catch up with Speed Racer & friends!
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Dive into an all‑new interpretation of Tatsuo Yoshida’s classic manga series, Speed Racer, with our latest comics bundle! Follow the adventures of Speed, Trixie, Pops, Spritle, and Chim Chim as they race to save the day in the iconic symbol of speed and gadgetry—the Mach Five. Discover the high‑speed action of this timeless franchise! And, if that’s not enough adventure for you, we’ve included the iconic Gatchaman series for the ultimate teamup! Both legendary series are in one awesome bundle—plus, your purchase helps support the Make‑A‑Wish Foundation.

expires_tomorrow.title: Lovecraftian Horrors: STL Miniatures Mega Bundle by NSMiniatures
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Make your party and foes alike quake in fear at your gorgeously customized miniatures with the all‑new Lovecraftian Horrors: STL Miniatures Mega Bundle by NSMiniatures! Print your own witch‑blood‑drinking, Satan‑worshiping minis from the The Dunwich Horror - Miniatures + Props Collection, erect windowless crypts dripping with spirits of evil with the Cult of Nyarlathotep - Miniatures + Terrain Collection, and more with 15+ total packs to choose from. Add depth and darkness to your game night with fully customizable miniatures from the wizards at NSMiniatures, and help support Make‑A‑Wish with your purchase!
